calls.title: Discuss Pricing/Packaging
calls.summary: The team discussed strategies for optimizing pricing and packaging models to drive upgrades from Pro to Enterprise. Key points included implementing user seat caps around 10 and higher seat pricing to create better value for larger customers and prevent price gaming. Features such as audit logs, SSO, and granular role-based access would be limited to Enterprise, while Pro would have caps on usage rather than restricting features. A debate between pricing metrics favored events over MAUs due to their better alignment with experimentation activities. The conversation included customer segmentation, emphasizing distinct value tiers for Free, Pro, and Enterprise packages. Governance features emerged as significant upgrade motivators, and there was a need to assess the billing system's capability to enforce usage caps effectively.
calls.keywords: pricing strategy, packaging tiers, warehouse native, enterprise features, usage caps, feature flagging
